name: Nereid v8 — Section 11: Linked Places, Systems and Handoffs
tagline: The trousers accept their assignment or perish. And the Gremlindex never receives the Consent Menu.
body:
PROJECT NEREID CREATES AND RECORDS THE FINISHED BODY. Other systems may receive THE MINIMUM INFORMATION NEEDED to clothe it, recognise it, support it or describe it. NONE INHERITS AUTHORITY OVER ITS CREATION.

SILKEN EMBRACE RECEIVES THE FINISHED BODY RATHER THAN INFLUENCING WHAT NEREID BUILDS. With her permission it translates the approved record into bras, panties, support, containment, compression, movement allowances, pocketing, cock-and-ball accommodation, bulge presentation, workwear, formalwear, sleepwear, and CLOTHING CAPABLE OF SURVIVING HER ACTUAL BUILD.
THE HANDOFF MAY INCLUDE Stature, Framing, measurements, Build-governed expansion and recruitment, tit Shape and Cup, Full Chest Integration, ass Shape and Scale, SHELF LIFT, Cheek Plump, hip canvas, Carriage, thigh anatomy, Motion WHERE FABRIC MUST ANSWER IT, cock-and-ball dimensions, Total Package Presentation and relevant Hair length.
IT DOES NOT RECEIVE her complete Consent Menu, HANDFEEL WHERE FABRIC HAS NO JURISDICTION, Devotion Tell, sensitivity map, fertility history, or private sexual record. WHICH SETTLES SOMETHING THE ARCHIVE HAD ONLY ASSUMED: SILKEN EMBRACE DOES NOT GET HANDFEEL. A garment has no business knowing what a wife’s hand meets.
THE THREE LINES THE BOUTIQUE WORKS BY:
NEREID CREATES THE TITS. THE BRA CREATES CLEAVAGE.
NEREID CREATES THE COCK AND BALLS. SILKEN EMBRACE DECIDES WHAT THE FABRIC ADMITS.
NEREID CREATES THE ASS. THE TROUSERS ACCEPT THEIR ASSIGNMENT OR PERISH.

CALDERON RECORDS receive three facts and no more. GENDER: SHEMALE. PRONOUNS: SHE / HER. AFFIRMATION STATUS: NEREID-AFFIRMED OR BORN-SHEMALE, WHERE MEDICALLY RELEVANT. Government records DO NOT RECEIVE the complete anatomical, sexual, relational or Secret Menu history held by the Clinic. A LEGAL IDENTITY REQUIRES NEITHER COCK MEASUREMENTS NOR AN EXPLANATION OF WHAT HER ASS DOES WHEN HER WIFE WALKS INTO THE ROOM.

INDIVIDUAL PROFILES AND THE GREMLINDEX. The Clinic Confirmation Record supplies VERIFIED ANATOMY; an individual profile translates it into readable first impressions, bodily modifications, Combined Expressions, household nicknames, clothing life, known tells, AND THE DETAILS THROUGH WHICH THE FAMILY ACTUALLY RECOGNISES HER.
THE GREMLINDEX RECEIVES ONLY THE ULTRA-COMPACT AT-A-GLANCE VERSION — ENOUGH TO ANSWER HERE SHE IS WITHOUT REPRODUCING THE BODY’S ENGINEERING FILE. It may hold a readable Body Summary, Stature, Primary Build, adopted secondary traits, compact upper- and lower-body expressions, cock specifications, Hair, Vibe Typing, clothing, family role, tells, quotes, defining moment, Field Note, Continuity Guardrail and Threat Index. IT NEVER RECEIVES THE COMPLETE CONSENT MENU.
AND THE DOCUMENT GIVES THE HOUSEHOLD ITS OWN EXAMPLE OF THE TWO REGISTERS SITTING SIDE BY SIDE: ALL DOUBLE-CHEEKED UP BEFORE COFFEE may be emotionally exact; WORK-WROUGHT DOUBLE SHELF, VALKYRIE BRACE LINE, REMAINS THE MEDICAL RECORD. HOUSEHOLD NICKNAMES MAY LIVE BESIDE STANDARDISED CLINIC ANATOMY. THEY DO NOT REPLACE IT — which is the same ruling the Archive already carries on adoption notation.

COUPLE MATCHING reads two completed bodies and addresses compatibility AFTERWARD. IT CANNOT REOPEN EITHER WOMAN’S CONSENT MENU ON THE THEORY THAT LOVE SHOULD HAVE CHOSEN DIFFERENTLY. NO PARTNER’S WISH OUTRANKS THE BODY’S AUTHOR. COMPATIBILITY BEGINS AFTER TWO COMPLETE ANSWERS, NOT BY TURNING ONE WOMAN INTO THE OTHER’S QUESTIONNAIRE.

THE CLOSING LAW, AND IT IS THE LAST WORD IN THE DOCUMENT. Project Nereid begins with a woman imagining and ends with her living, and everything between those acts exists TO KEEP THE SECOND ACT ANSWERABLE TO THE FIRST.
NEREID DOES NOT CREATE WOMEN. It does not award womanhood, manufacture devotion, guarantee happiness, cure loneliness, erase history, or decide the life an affirmed body must lead. IT GIVES BIOLOGICAL TRUTH THE REACH TO BECOME VISIBLE, TACTILE, STRONG, SOFT, HUNGRY, RESTED, DRESSED, NAKED, LOVED, RIDICULOUS, AND REAL.
EDEN BUILT A WEAPON THAT COMMANDED FLESH. MARIANNE REBUILT IT INTO A SYSTEM THAT LISTENS. CASSANDRA GAVE IT THE LAW IT MUST NEVER OUTGROW:
THE WOMAN AUTHORS THE BODY.
